name: Kon Tum Provincial Museum
summary: Walk the provincial museum at 659 Nguyen Hue. An adult pays 20,000 VND, or 10,000 VND. A child pays 10,000 VND, or 5,000 VND, and children and school students are also admitted free. Hours are Check on arrival.
getThere: Walk or ride along Nguyen Hue to number 659.
heroCaption: The museum building on Nguyen Hue
gettingThere: The museum is at 659 Nguyễn Huệ, in Kon Tum ward, a branch of the Quảng Ngãi general museum. Walk or ride from the centre along Nguyen Hue. The minute count is Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the centre
legs.body: Walk or ride along Nguyen Hue to number 659. The minute count is Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Pleiku Airport (PXU)
legs.body: By bus or taxi into Kon Tum, then along Nguyen Hue. The road from the airport is nearly 45 km, or 51 km, about an hour, or 50 km in 1 to 1.5 hours by car and about 1.5 hours by bus.

admissionNote: An adult pays 20,000 VND, or 10,000 VND. A child pays 10,000 VND, or 5,000 VND, and children and school students are also admitted free. People with a disability, people in poor or near-poor households, and people with recognised service to the revolution are free. Seniors, students in training, recognised artisans, and visitors on 24 November pay half. If more than one reduction applies, only the largest one is used. The 20,000 VND tariff started on 18 August 2026.

links.label: 2026 visit fees
links.note: Adult 20,000 VND and child 10,000 VND from 18 August 2026, at 659 Nguyen Hue
